name: Related Skills
headline: AI Automation Agency Builder: Launch Your AI Agency
short_description: This skill guides users in establishing a one-person AI automation agency by leveraging AI tools to create and sell automation systems to businesses. It walks through identifying target clients and implementing effective outreach strategies to grow an AI-driven business.
author: shyft-ai

sections.overview:
The AI Automation Agency Builder skill is designed to empower users to establish a one-person AI automation agency. This skill provides a step-by-step guide on leveraging AI tools to create and sell automation systems tailored for businesses. Users will learn how to identify target clients and implement effective outreach strategies, making it an ideal resource for those looking to enter the AI development and marketing space. One of the key benefits of this skill is its ability to save time by streamlining the process of setting up an AI automation agency. With a quick implementation time of just one hour, users can quickly gain the knowledge needed to start their journey in AI automation. This skill is particularly useful for beginners who may not have extensive experience in AI or business development, enabling them to take actionable steps toward building a profitable venture. The AI Automation Agency Builder is suitable for a wide range of professionals, including developers, product managers, and AI practitioners. Anyone interested in creating AI-driven solutions for local businesses will find this skill invaluable. Practical use cases include developing an AI automation system for local businesses, conducting cold email outreach to acquire business clients, and leveraging AI tools to automate various business processes. By following the guidance provided in this skill, users can effectively position themselves in the growing AI market. With its beginner-friendly approach, the AI Automation Agency Builder skill fits seamlessly into AI-first workflows. Users do not need any prior experience to get started, making it accessible to anyone eager to explore AI automation. By integrating this skill into their toolkit, professionals can enhance their workflow automation capabilities and drive significant value for their clients, ultimately contributing to the growth of their own AI-driven businesses.
Creating an AI automation system for local businesses
Conducting cold email outreach to acquire business clients
Leveraging AI tools to automate business processes
sections.setup: No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
sections.usage:
```
To build your AI automation agency, use the following three-step approach: 

1. **Identify Your Target System**: Choose one of the following AI systems to offer: 
   - Speed-to-lead system
   - WhatsApp/SMS AI booking system
   - Social media AI DM bot
   - AI receptionist system

2. **Create Your AI System**: Use no-code tools to build the chosen system. Refer to online guides or tutorials to aid in the construction process.

3. **Execute Cold Email Campaign**: Develop a targeted email campaign using tools like Apollo.io. 
   - Identify local businesses that would benefit from your system based on their AI adoption level.
   - Use AI tools to draft an engaging email [EMAIL_TEMPLATE] and automate follow-ups.

Example Email Template: [EMAIL_TEMPLATE]
- Subject: "Revolutionize Your Customer Engagement with AI"
- Body: "Hi [BUSINESS_NAME],
   
  Are you looking to optimize your customer interactions and increase engagement? Our [SYSTEM_NAME] offers...

Sign off with your contact information and a call to action.
```
Copy

```
Example of what the AI would generate:

Subject: Revolutionize Your Customer Engagement with AI

Hi CleanUp Pros,

Are you looking to optimize your customer interactions and increase engagement? Our AI receptionist system offers automated response solutions and 24/7 appointment scheduling, saving you time and improving customer satisfaction.

Interested in learning more? Let's schedule a quick call to discuss how we can tailor this solution to fit your business needs.

Best regards,
Lee Mley
Contact: lee@aiautomationsolutions.com
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf
Advanced skill - requires experience with AI agents
